scope: Cloudflare Email Service adapter, configured provider selection and provider-independent browser/stored attachment sources.
behavior: Cloudflare uses shared bounded HTTP and raw MIME, explicit envelope recipients, validated account/token settings, a 5 MiB MIME ceiling and conservative acceptance/error classification.
Named configured mailers and failover use the existing application assembly and generated schema, including environment token overrides.
Message.AttachUpload snapshots a bounded captured upload, detects its media type and closes its reader; no attachment record or storage object is required.
Message.AttachStored accepts stored File, Attachment and loaded One model slots; EmailAttachment exposes a version/ETag-pinned reference for typed queue payloads.
Every adapter consumes the shared prepared attachment representation; consumers do not encode provider blobs.
Runtime upload bytes remain unsuitable for durable queue snapshots until persisted; stored references do not prevent object deletion.

generation.result: Generated one owned configuration file and its manifest; final make verify confirmed all generated output current.

full_gate.result: Native Go 1.27.1 darwin/arm64; formatting, vet, root tests, independent fixtures/compiler cases, generation, documentation and release tools passed.

focused_races_postgres.environment: Existing .env.test loaded privately; PostgreSQL required; retained isolated test namespaces and temporary storage.

consumer_races_postgres.environment: Existing .env.test loaded privately; PostgreSQL required. Refreshed after concurrent imaging source edits.

compiler_rejections.result: Raw readers and string paths fail at their intended attachment interfaces; also included in the full fixture gate.

editor.result: All four real gopls completion/hover/definition probes passed.

failures_and_corrections: The initial stored-reference unit fixture used an invalid unquoted ETag; corrected the fixture to the existing storage contract without relaxing runtime validation.
Early race/consumer attempts encountered concurrent incomplete imaging edits. They were preserved; the final required checks passed after those source definitions became available.

The first full gate exposed a stale CLI test expecting three generated client artifacts. Verified the current entry, two runtime modules, manifest and OpenAPI output and corrected that test to five; the subsequent complete gate passed.
review: No new dependencies or parallel mail/queue/storage implementations.
Attachment source interfaces share the existing upload owner; HTTP is not imported by email.
Readers close on success, read/open/close failure, cancellation and isolated panic/Goexit; no partial message is exposed on helper failure.
BCC stays in the envelope and out of MIME; provider identity and credential settings remain instance-owned.
Ambiguous submission does not trigger failover; recipient bounces do not undo known provider acceptance.
Independent browser and PostgreSQL model consumers prove the public path, including post-request cleanup and missing stored content before submission.
verification_limits: Real-account provider delivery was not tested and no external email was sent.
Concurrent imaging and pagination work outside this mail scope was preserved; this is not an audit of those features.
